lines: Nineteen design-system pages are now components in one library, built once and used everywhere.
Earlier screens drew their own versions. Now a screen takes the component by its design-system name.
Buttons in every variant and size. A busy button ignores a second press.
One form field gives every control its label, hint and error, tied together for screen readers. Sign in and Join already use it.
Checkboxes, radios, switches and toggles carry their state as attributes, never colour alone.
Chips, badges, counts and avatars. A photo that fails shows initials.
A spinner waits before it shows. A tooltip hides on Escape. A skip link jumps to the content.
Every behaviour has a test that failed first, and the first load did not grow.
Next, feedback and overlays, then layout.
That's slice one point four. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
